memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Routine dyslipidaemia review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient comes for regular follow‑up of high cholesterol, reports no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/82 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Advised to reduce saturated fat intake and increase walking to 30 minutes daily.
IMPRESSION: Dyslipidaemia, stable. Ordered fasting lipid profile, liver function test and creatine kinase to assess statin safety.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start atorvastatin 10 mg at bedtime. Review in 3 months. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 138 mg/dL (optimal <100), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40 good), triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150 normal). Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (7‑56), AST 24 U/L (10‑40), ALKP 78 U/L (30‑120), GGT 32 U/L (0‑51). Creatine kinase: 92 U/L (30‑200).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Check lipid response and muscle symptoms.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes occasional mild thigh discomfort after walks, otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/84 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Advised to maintain low‑salt diet and gentle stretching.
IMPRESSION: Dyslipidaemia, LDL still elevated. CK normal, no significant myalgia. Consider switching to rosuvastatin for better LDL reduction.
ARRANGEMENTS: Stop atorvastatin, start rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Repeat labs in 6 weeks. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 112 mg/dL, HDL 44 mg/dL, triglycerides 158 mg/dL. Liver function: ALT 30 U/L, AST 26 U/L, ALKP 80 U/L, GGT 34 U/L. Creatine kinase: 95 U/L.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have felt a slight ache in my calves when climbing stairs, but it goes away with rest. No fever or other issues.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Resting ECG: sinus rhythm 72 bpm, no ST‑T changes, no evidence of ischemia. Normal study.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient comes for routine check‑up, reports mild calf ache only on exertion, otherwise fine.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/80 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 24.2 (overweight). Advised to continue balanced diet and daily walks.
IMPRESSION: Dyslipidaemia, LDL improved but still above target. Ordered fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, liver function and CK for annual screening.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Give influenza vaccine today (01‑Oct‑2025). Review in 3 months. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 105 mg/dL, HDL 45 mg/dL, triglycerides 150 mg/dL. Fasting blood sugar: 92 mg/dL (70‑99 normal). Liver function: ALT 27 U/L, AST 23 U/L, ALKP 76 U/L, GGT 30 U/L. Creatine kinase: 88 U/L.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Rosuvastatin 10 mg OD
Fenofibrate 145 mg OD

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 01‑Feb‑2026 at 10:00 am with Dr Priya Natarajan.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Post‑holiday lipid check.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient returns for scheduled review, feels well, no new complaints.
EXAMINATION: BP 142/86 mmHg, weight 71 kg, BMI 24.5 (overweight). Advised to watch portion sizes and maintain activity.
IMPRESSION: Dyslipidaemia on rosuvastatin and fenofibrate, lipids satisfactory. No medication changes needed.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current regimen. Influenza vaccine status: given 01‑Oct‑2025, up to date. Review in 3 months. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 108 mg/dL, HDL 46 mg/dL, triglycerides 148 mg/dL. Liver function: ALT 29 U/L, AST 25 U/L, ALKP 79 U/L, GGT 33 U/L. Creatine kinase: 90 U/L.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual dyslipidaemia review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient attends for routine follow‑up, denies chest pain, dyspnoea or fever.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/84 mmHg, weight 72 kg, BMI 24.9 (overweight). Advised to reduce refined carbs and increase vegetable intake.
IMPRESSION: Dyslipidaemia, LDL borderline high. Ordered fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, liver function and CK for yearly screening.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue rosuvastatin 10 mg OD and fenofibrate 145 mg OD. Influenza vaccine status: given 01‑Oct‑2025, still valid. Review in 6 months. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Rosuvastatin 20 mg OD
Fenofibrate 145 mg OD

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the medicines as prescribed and feel good. No muscle pain or stomach upset.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Autumn review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient comes for regular check‑up, reports feeling well, no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/82 mmHg, weight 73 kg, BMI 25.2 (obese). Advised to adopt a Mediterranean‑style diet and aim for 150 minutes of weekly aerobic activity.
IMPRESSION: Dyslipidaemia, LDL well controlled on current regimen. Ordered fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, liver function and CK for annual review.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue rosuvastatin 20 mg OD and fenofibrate 145 mg OD. Give influenza vaccine today (05‑Oct‑2026). Review in 4 months. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.
